sb_prompt: DISCUSS GUN CONTROL.  WHERE DO YOU AND THE OTHER CALLER STAND ON A SCALE FROM 1 TO 10
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hello!
ParticipantB: Hey!
ParticipantA: Yeah, I was just looking at some news about the shooting downtown and it got me thinking. You know, what do you think? Like, where are we on this gun control thing?
ParticipantB: Oh, right. Honestly? I'm probably around a 4 or 5. Kinda in the middle, I guess.
ParticipantA: Wow, really? I'm definitely more of a 9. Maybe even an 10 if I'm being honest.
ParticipantB: Man, a 10? That's pretty serious. My cousin got arrested a couple years back for having a loaded rifle in his truck. He said he felt safer with it, but it ended up looking real bad in court.
ParticipantA: Oh, that sucks for your cousin. Yeah, I see where you're coming from. But for me, it's just about respect for other people's safety. I work as an electrician, you know?
ParticipantB: Oh, yeah? How's that going?
ParticipantA: It's awesome. I love it. I've been doing this since I was like 20. I made up my mind way back then. I just knew I wanted to be out there working, not sitting in an office.
ParticipantB: That's cool. I actually went to college for finance, though. Kinda changed my mind about what I wanted to do after a while. Now I'm a bank teller.
ParticipantA: Oh, nice! I've always kind of looked up to people who work in the city. You see more of society, right?
ParticipantB: Yeah, definitely. Every day, people come in with all kinds of problems. Some are scared, some are angry. It's just... it's a lot of pressure. Makes me want to keep my options open.
ParticipantA: I get that. But honestly, when I'm up in the attic fixing wiring, I don't want anyone to walk up and shoot me because I'm working. It's not about politics, really. It's just about being able to do my job without fear.
ParticipantB: I mean, I agree about the fear part. That's for sure. My cousin's story is why I lean toward 4. I don't want people afraid of their own families. But I also don't want a crazy person getting a weapon easily.
ParticipantA: Right? That's the thing. It feels like we're both trying to protect people, just in different ways. I think stricter laws would actually make it safer for my crew.
ParticipantB: Hmm. Maybe we just disagree on the best way to do it.
ParticipantA: Totally. Look, I'm gonna head out to a job site, actually. Got a call at 10.
ParticipantB: Oh, yeah? Good luck with that.
ParticipantA: Thanks. You stick to the bank stuff, right?
ParticipantB: Yeah, I will. Talk later?
ParticipantA: Yeah, maybe.
ParticipantB: Cool. Bye.
ParticipantA: Bye.
